blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can answer clinical questions about medical images, but trustworthy use requires visual grounding: models should localize the pathology they report rather than rely on spurious shortcuts. Whether MLLMs can visually ground clinical findings in retinal optical coherence tomography (OCT), the most widely used imaging modality in ophthalmology, remains largely unexplored. To address this gap, we introduce RetinaGroundBench, the first benchmark for biomarker visual grounding in retinal OCT. It comprises 815 B-scans exhaustively annotated by ophthalmologists with 4,537 bounding boxes covering 13 biomarkers across 8 diseases. Because MLLMs often fragment a single lesion into multiple partial predictions, we propose AggIoU, a metric that evaluates whether the union of overlapping predicted boxes covers the annotated region. Across 27 open-source MLLMs (0.8-38B parameters), we find that visual grounding remains largely unsolved: the best general-purpose model achieves a macro F1 of just 23.7%, with consistently low recall, despite reaching up to 73% balanced accuracy on biomarker presence questions. To narrow this gap, we developed RetGrounder, an MLLM fine-tuned using an OCT-specific strategy integrating grounding and textual information. Despite its relatively small size (8B), RetGrounder improves grounding F1 to 33.9%, a 43% relative improvement. Our benchmark provides a reference point for measuring progress in the field of OCT diagnosis with MLLMs.
blocks.zh: 多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs)可以回答关于医疗影像的临床问题,但值得信赖的用途需要视觉地面:模型应该将所报道的病理学本地化,而不是依赖虚假的捷径. 在视网膜光学一致性成像学(OCT)中,MLLMS能否在视网膜光学一致性成像学(OCT)中观测到地面临床发现,这是眼科中最广泛使用的成像方式,但基本上仍未加以探索. 为了弥补这一差距,我们引入了RetinaGround Bench,这是视网膜OCT中生物标记器视觉地面的第一个基准. 它由815个B-扫描仪组成,由眼科医生详细注释,有4 537个边框,覆盖8种疾病的13个生物标记。 由于MLLMs经常将单个损伤片断成多个部分预测,我们提出AggIoU,这个衡量标准用来评价重叠预测框的结合是否覆盖了注解区域. 在27个开源的MLLMs(0.8-38B参数)中,我们发现视觉地面基本上仍未解决:最好的通用模型只实现了23.7%的宏F1,但回溯率一直很低,尽管在生物标志存在问题上达到了高达73%的平衡精确度。 为了缩小这一差距,我们开发了RetGauer,这是一种利用OCT特定战略进行微调的MLLM,将地面信息和文字信息结合起来。 尽管面积相对较小(8B),但RetGamber改进了F1至33.9%的地基,相对改善43%. 我们的基准为衡量OCT诊断领域用MLLMs进行的进展提供了一个参考点。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), which combine language and vision encoders to jointly process images and text, have demonstrated great potential as assistants to ophthalmologists [ 1 , 7 , 36 , 39 , 2 , 16 ] . The visual question-answering (VQA) ability of these models is of particular interest, as it allows users to query a model about the presence of diseases or lesions in an image [ 32 ] . However, for such assistants to be trusted in clinical practice, they must not only answer accurately, but also indicate the visual evidence behind each answer.
This capability is known as visual grounding , in which a model outputs the spatial location of a queried finding.
Without such grounding, a textual answer gives clinicians no way to confirm that a model attended to the relevant pathology rather than exploiting spurious correlations or learned shortcuts [ 9 ] , or simply hallucinating. This lack of verifiability is a central barrier to clinical adoption [ 18 ] . Assessing whether current MLLMs can be trusted therefore requires understanding not only their diagnostic question answering ability but also their capacity to spatially localise the pathology underlying those answers.
blocks.zh:
多式大语言模型(MLLMs),将语言和视觉编码器结合到联合处理图像和文本上,展现出作为眼科医生助手的巨大潜力[1,7,36,39,2,16]. 这些模型的视觉问答能力(VQA)特别受关注,因为它允许用户查询一个模型在图像中是否存在疾病或损伤[32]. 然而,为了让这些助手在临床实践中得到信任,他们不仅必须准确回答,还必须说明每个回答背后的视觉证据.
这种能力被称为可视定位,其中一个模型输出被询问的发现的空间位置.
没有这种基础,文本的答案就使临床医生无法确认一个模型关注相关的病理学,而不是利用虚假的关联或学到的捷径[9],或者仅仅是幻觉. 缺乏可核查性是临床采纳的一个中心障碍[18]. 因此,评估能否相信目前的MLLMs,不仅需要了解其诊断问题回答能力,而且需要了解其空间定位这些答案背后的病理的能力。

blocks.en:
Most previous studies focused on evaluating MLLMs in terms of
examination performance and diagnosis on real clinical cases [ 1 , 7 , 36 , 39 , 2 ] . In the former category, frontier models (including
GPT-5 [ 28 ] , Gemini 2.5 Pro [ 12 ] , Claude Sonnet 4.0 [ 3 ] , and DeepSeek-V3 [ 8 ] ) have improved substantially on the Fellowship of the Royal College of Ophthalmologists (FRCOphth) examinations since 2023, with the best-performing model, Gemini 2.5 Pro, exceeding typical top human candidate scores. However, error analysis still revealed critical reasoning deficits such as premature diagnostic closure and confidently unjustified decisions [ 1 ] . On real clinical cases, rather than curated examination questions, the evidence is more mixed: on 50 retinal optical coherence tomography (OCT) and OCT angiography (OCT-A) cases, GPT-4o diagnosed 62% correctly versus Gemini’s 32% [ 7 ] ; Med-Gemini surpassed baselines on 18 of 20 medical image classification tasks including ophthalmology [ 36 ] ; and GPT-4o matched clinicians in differential glaucoma diagnosis on OCT while struggling with primary diagnosis [ 39 ] , with further evidence of effective few-shot retinal disease diagnosis on OCT [ 2 ] .

blocks.en:
Several models have also been developed specifically for ophthalmology. OphGLM [ 10 ] was the first, combining ConvNext [ 25 ] , BERT [ 11 ] , and ChatGLM-6B [ 14 ] for fundus diagnostics; VisionUnite [ 23 ] added open-ended multi-disease fundus diagnosis with clinical explanations, and EyeCLIP [ 31 ] , pre-trained on 2.77 million images across 11 modalities, achieved strong classification and cross-modal retrieval. For OCT specifically, LO-VLM [ 15 ] targets anatomical layer-specific interpretation and RetinaVLM [ 16 ] , age-related macula degeneration (AMD) staging,
approaching junior-ophthalmologist performance. Despite this diversity, these models share a limitation that matters for clinical verification: their outputs are text—a diagnosis, a disease stage, or a free-text description—with no indication of the image evidence behind them. Their scope is narrow as well, and the two OCT-specific models each address a single task. None can be queried for the location of an arbitrary biomarker.

blocks.en: Several ophthalmology-specific VQA benchmarks have been proposed, though none assess visual grounding. LMOD+ [ 30 ] is the most systematic, testing 24 MLLMs on 32,633 images across 5 ophthalmic imaging modalities including OCT, but its spatial annotations cover only anatomical structures (e.g., retina, choroid), not fine-grained biomarkers. OphthalWeChat [ 35 ] and MedBench [ 24 ] likewise evaluate ophthalmic VQA, and FunBench [ 33 ] organises tasks hierarchically across modality, anatomy, lesion, and disease. Across all of these, the performance of MLLMs still lags behind supervised networks, and no benchmark requires models to localise the pathology underlying their answers.
blocks.zh: 一些眼科的特异性 提出了VQA基准,但没有评估可视地面。 LMOD+ [30]是最系统的,在包括OCT在内的5个眼成像模式上的32,633个图像上测试了24个MLLM,但其空间说明只覆盖解剖结构(如视网膜,胆固醇等),而不是细纹活标. 视网膜[35]和MedBench[24]同样评价视网膜VQA,而FunBench[33]则分层次组织不同模式、解剖、损伤和疾病的任务。 在所有这一切中,MLLMs的性能仍然落后于被监管的网络,没有基准要求模型将答案背后的病理本地化.

blocks.en: To contextualize existing gaps, prior work can be placed along two hierarchies. The image domain narrows from general medical imaging, through ophthalmology, to retinal OCT specifically; the task deepens from language-only assessment, through VQA on an image, to grounded VQA, in which a model must also localise the finding it reports. Retinal OCT already appears at the shallow end of the task hierarchy—evaluated, in the benchmarks above, as VQA or anatomical recognition, but never biomarker grounding. Grounding, conversely, has been explored further in other specialties—radiology [ 5 ] , pathology [ 41 ] , and sequential medical images [ 38 ] —but not brought down to ophthalmic biomarkers. No prior benchmark occupies the intersection of the two: grounded VQA of biomarkers on retinal OCT, despite it being the most widely used imaging modality in ophthalmology and the diagnostic gold standard for a broad range of retinal diseases.
blocks.zh: 为了将现有差距放在背景上,可以将先前的工作按两个等级排列。 图像域从一般的医学成像,通过眼科,到视网膜OCT,具体而言;任务从只使用语言的评估,通过图像上的VQA来加深到基于VQA,其中模型还必须将它报告的发现本地化. 视网膜OCT已经出现在任务等级的浅端 -- -- 在上述基准中被评价为VQA或解剖识别,但从未出现生物标记。 反之,其他专业——放射学[5]、病理学[41]和相继的医学图像[38]——进一步探索了地表测量,但没有降入眼球生物标记。 先前的基准没有一项占据了两者之间的交叉点:在视网膜OCT上植入生物标记的VQA,尽管它是眼科中最广泛使用的成像模式,也是广泛视网膜疾病的诊断金本位。

blocks.en: Purely in terms of data, retinal OCT is well served by classification, segmentation, and lesion detection datasets [ 6 , 19 , 29 , 21 , 26 , 4 ] , but none supports the task we study. Classification datasets carry no spatial annotation. Segmentation and detection datasets do localise lesions, but their annotations are tied to a closed set of classes fixed in advance rather than to a clinician’s query, so they cannot test whether a model retrieves the correct finding when asked in natural language; and their dense-mask output is mismatched to the text coordinates MLLMs emit, so scoring an MLLM against them would measure mask generation rather than spatial grounding.
blocks.zh: 纯粹在数据方面,视网膜OCT通过分类、分解和损伤检测数据集[6、19、29、21、26、4]得到很好的服务,但没有一项数据支持我们研究的任务。 分类数据集没有空间注释. 分解和检测数据集确实能将损伤本地化,但其说明被绑在预先固定的封闭的一组类上,而不是临床医生的询问上,因此无法测试一个模型在以自然语言被问及时是否检索到正确的发现;并且其密集的掩码输出会与文本坐标MLLMs放出相不匹配,因此对照它们评分一个MLLLM会测量掩码生成而不是空间地平.

blocks.en:
Grounding retinal OCT biomarkers is not simply the same task in a new modality; three obstacles stand in the way. The first is the pathology. Unlike the discrete, well-bounded objects of natural-image grounding, many retinal biomarkers are diffuse and low-contrast, recur as many small instances across a single B-scan, and have extents expert graders themselves would draw differently, e.g., drusen and
fibrosis.
The second is the output format: an MLLM must serialise a spatial extent as coordinate tokens through an autoregressive language decoder, so whatever spatial detail its vision encoder captures must survive translation into text, a constraint no purpose-built detector faces. The third is measurement: conventional detection metrics assume one box per instance and match greedily one-to-one, yet MLLMs scatter several partial boxes across a single lesion, so a model that has in substance found the lesion is scored as one hit and several false alarms. Any assessment of medical grounding must therefore contend not only with whether models can localise pathology, but with whether our instruments can tell.
blocks.zh:
将视网膜OCT生物标记投放在地上并不仅仅是以新方式完成的同一项任务;三个障碍阻碍着道路。 第一种是病理论. 许多视网膜生物标记与自然成像地平面的离散、范围很广的物体不同的是,许多视网膜生物标记是分散和低相接的,在单一的B-扫描仪上重复发生许多小事件,并且有程度鉴定仪本身会画出不同的东西,例如:德鲁森和德鲁森。
纤维化
第二是输出格式: MLLM必须通过自相递回语言解码器将空间范围序列化为坐标符,所以无论它的视觉编码器捕获的空间细节都必须活下来被翻译为文本,这是没有目的所构建的探测器面孔的制约. 第三是衡量:常规的检测度量衡假设每例一箱并贪婪地一对一相匹配,而MLLMs却将多个部分箱分散在一个单一的损伤上,因此一个实质上发现损伤的模型被打成一发和多发假警报. 因此,对医疗基础的任何评估都必须不仅针对模型是否能够将病理本地化,而且针对我们的仪器能否辨别。

blocks.en:
These obstacles, together with the absence of ophthalmic visual grounding benchmarks and the clinician’s need to verify that model answers are visually grounded, motivate our benchmark contribution, RetinaGroundBench.
This is the first visual grounding benchmark for retinal OCT lesion localisation, spanning 13 lesion types evaluated across state-of-the-art open-source MLLMs. To measure grounding as MLLMs actually perform it, we further propose Aggregated IoU (AggIoU) (Fig. 1 c), which scores each ground-truth box against the union of the predictions that overlap it rather than against a single greedily matched box: a lesion covered collectively by several partial predictions is credited as found, while predictions that substantially overshoot or undershoot the target are still penalised. Finally, motivated by the documented failure of out-of-the-box MLLMs at spatial localisation for OCT, we introduce RetGrounder, a domain-adapted model demonstrating that diverse targeted fine-tuning can substantially narrow the medical visual grounding gap. In summary, this work contributes a new benchmark (RetinaGroundBench), a new visual grounding metric (AggIoU), and a new domain-adapted MLLM (RetGrounder) capable of visual grounding on retinal OCT.
blocks.zh:
这些障碍,加上缺乏眼球视觉定位基准,以及临床医生需要验证模型答案是否具有视觉基础,激励着我们的基准贡献RetinaGround Bench。
这是视网膜OCT损伤局部化的第一个可视化地基基准,涵盖对最新开源MLLMs评价的13种损伤类型. 为了衡量MLLMs实际执行时的地平面值,我们进一步提议综合IoU(图1c),根据重叠的预测,而不是一个贪婪相匹配的预测,对每个地平线框进行计分:若干部分预测所共同覆盖的损伤按所发现的计算,而严重射出或射出目标的预测仍然受到惩罚。 最后,由于OCT空间定位的外置MLLMs的有文件记载的失败,我们引入了RetGrounder,一种经过域调整的模型,表明不同的定向微调可以大大地缩小医学视觉地平面的缺口. 简而言之,本作贡献了一个新的基准(RetinaGround Bench),一个新的视觉地平面测量标准(AggIoU),以及一个新的能以视网膜OCT为地平面的新域适应MLLM(RetGrounder).

blocks.zh: 2 结果

blocks.en: 2.1 Overview
blocks.zh: 2.1 概览

blocks.en:
Fig. 1 gives an overview of the benchmark and the evaluation framework. RetinaGroundBench comprises 815 retinal OCT B-scans drawn from two public datasets: OCTDL [ 21 ] and OLIVES [ 29 ] , annotated by ophthalmologists with 4,537 bounding boxes across 13 biomarker classes (Methods, Table 4 ):
drusen, ellipsoid zone (EZ) disruption, epiretinal membrane (ERM), fibrosis, hard exudates (HE), hyperreflective foci (HRF), intraretinal fluid (IRF), macular hole (MH), pigment epithelial detachment (PED), retinal pigment epithelium (RPE) loss, subretinal drusenoid deposits (SDD), subretinal fluid (SRF), and vitreomacular traction (VMT).

drusen),椭圆形区间断裂(EZ),上皮膜(ERM),纤维化,硬出血(HE),高反射分叉(HRF),内膜液(IRF),毛孔(MH),色素上皮分叉(PED),视网膜上皮(RPE)损耗(RPE),下皮分叉(SDD)沉积(SDD),下皮液(SRF)和视网膜拉力(VMT).

blocks.en:
Table 1 compares RetinaGroundBench with existing retinal OCT datasets that provide spatial annotations and with ophthalmic MLLM benchmarks. OCT5k supplies biomarker bounding boxes but no MLLM protocol, and although its class count is comparable (9), its categories are concentrated within AMD-related biomarkers (e.g. five drusen subtypes), whereas RetinaGroundBench spans 13 distinct pathology types across 8 diseases. Conversely, ophthalmic MLLM benchmarks evaluate multimodal models but do not target biomarker grounding: LMOD+ restricts its spatial annotations to anatomical structures rather than fine-grained lesions, while FunBench and OphthalWeChat are VQA-only and carry no bounding-box annotations at all. RetinaGroundBench is thus the only resource that pairs biomarker-level bounding boxes with both a grounding and a VQA protocol, and it does so over more diseases and more biomarker classes than any of the alternatives, and across more evaluated models. Its image count is deliberately smaller: every box was placed by hand by retinal specialists, and the benchmark is sized for exhaustive per-instance annotation of all 13 biomarkers in every scan rather than for scale.
Unlike previous datasets, these classes are not a curated subset of lesions of interest, but the complete set of pathological findings observed in each image, so that the ground truth reflects a comprehensive assessment of every scan.
blocks.zh:
表1 比较 RetinaGround Bench 具有现有的视网膜OCT数据集,提供空间说明并带有视网膜MLLM基准. OCT5k提供生物标记框但无MLLM协议,虽然其类数相当(9),但其类别集中在AMD相关生物标记(如5个德鲁森亚型)中,而RetinaGround Bench横跨了8个疾病的13个不同的病理学类型. 反之,眼球MLLM基准评价了多模式模型,但没有瞄准生物标记地:LMOD+将其空间说明限制在解剖结构上,而不是细纹损伤上;而Fun Bench和OphersWeChat则只使用VQA并完全没有带边框说明. 因此,RetinaGround Bench是将生物标志级的边框与地面和VQA协议相配的唯一资源,它比任何替代品的疾病和生物标志级都要多,而且跨越了更多的评估模型。 它的图像计数刻意更小:每个盒子都是由视网膜专家手工放置的,基准大小是为了在每次扫描中对所有13个生物标记进行详尽的逐字说明,而不是规模说明.
与之前的数据集不同的是,这些类并非被整理的引起兴趣的损伤子集,而是每个图像所观察到的一整套病理学发现,这样地面真相就反映了对每次扫描的全面评估.

blocks.en: In our benchmark, we evaluate 27 state-of-the-art, general-purpose open-source MLLMs spanning four model families and multiple generations: Qwen3-VL, Qwen3.5, Qwen3.6, InternVL3, InternVL3.5, GLM-4.6V-Flash, and Gemma-4, with parameter counts ranging from 0.8B to 38B (see full list in Supplementary Table References ). All models were selected for their open weights and native bounding box output capability.

blocks.en:
Two additional components of this framework are also introduced in this work. The first is RetGrounder, obtained by fine-tuning Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct on a mixture of retinal OCT data spanning two task types: grounding data, comprising an in-house set of 34,112 annotated B-scans together with four public segmentation and detection datasets converted to bounding-box labels; and question-answering (QA) data, including classification data recast into VQA form and text-only QA pairs covering OCT biomarker knowledge.
Our model was also evaluated on RetinaGroundBench, resulting in 28 total benchmarked models.
blocks.zh:
这项工作还引入了该框架的两个额外组成部分。 第一个是RetGauer,通过微调Qune3-VL-8B-Instruct获得,其内容是涵盖两种任务类型的视网膜OCT数据的混合物:地面数据,包括一套由34,112个注解的B-扫描仪组成的内部数据集,以及被转换成边框标签的四个公共分块和检测数据集;以及问答数据,包括重新编成VQA格式的分类数据以及覆盖OCT生物标志知识的只文本的QA对.
我们的模型也在RetinaGround Bench上得到评价,结果得出28个总的基准模型.

blocks.en:
The second is AggIoU (Aggregated IoU), our grounding metric.
MLLMs rarely place a single box neatly around a lesion; instead, they tend to scatter several smaller boxes across it (Fig. 1 c), whereas human annotators often draw relatively large boxes spanning multiple instances of the same lesion [ 22 ] .
One-to-one detection matching accepts one of those boxes as the match and charges the rest as false positives, penalising a model that has in fact found the lesion. AggIoU instead scores each ground-truth box against the union of the predictions that overlap it: predictions overlapping a ground-truth box by more than a fraction
of the smaller box’s area are collected and their exact geometric union is recorded. AggIoU is then calculated as the IoU between the ground-truth box and that union. A ground-truth box counts as detected when its AggIoU exceeds a predefined value.
The metric therefore plays a dual role—it is both the reported measure of localisation quality and the criterion deciding true positives—and it credits predictions that collectively cover a lesion while still penalising those that are far larger or smaller than the target.
The Methods section describes in detail
the full procedure.
blocks.zh:
第二个是AggIoU(Aggreged IoU),这是我们的基础标准。
MLLMs很少将一个单一的盒子整齐地放置在一个损伤上;相反,它们往往会把几个较小的盒子散开(图1c),而人类的注释者往往会画出相对大的盒子,覆盖多个相同的损伤事件[22]。
一对一的检测匹配接受其中的一箱作为匹配,将其余部分作为假阳性,惩罚一个事实上已经发现损伤的模型. 反之,AggIoU将每个地真相盒与重叠的预测组合进行比对: 预测地真相盒重叠超过分数
并记录其准确的几何结合。 然后,AggIoU被计算为在地面真相箱和那个结合之间的IoU. 当 AggIoU 超过预定义值时, 地面真实框会计数为检测值 。
因此,衡量标准具有双重作用——它既是对本地化质量的衡量标准,也是决定真实阳性的标准——而且它能抵补各种预测,这些预测共同涵盖一种损伤,同时仍然惩罚那些远远大于或小于目标的损害。
方法部分详细介绍
整个程序。

blocks.en: Each model is assessed on two axes: visual grounding and visual question answering (VQA). For grounding, we report mean AggIoU alongside precision, recall, and F1; for VQA, we report balanced accuracy on binary presence questions. All metrics are computed over the combined OCTDL and OLIVES evaluation set: per-class scores are obtained by pooling all images from both datasets, then macro-averaged across all 13 biomarker classes so that each class contributes equally regardless of its prevalence or source dataset.
blocks.zh: 每个模型通过两个轴来评估:视觉地平面和视觉问答(VQA). 对于地面,我们报告指的是AggIoU与精度,回想和F1;对于VQA,我们报告二进制存在问题的平衡精度. 所有衡量标准都是通过OCTDL和OLIVES综合评价集计算出来的:通过汇集两个数据集的所有图像,然后对所有13个生物标志类进行宏观平均,从而使每一类无论普遍程度或源数据集如何,都能作出平等的贡献。

blocks.en:
The resulting landscape is markedly asymmetric: all evaluated models exhibited a pronounced precision–recall imbalance for visual grounding, with precision exceeding recall for every model. Most open-source models clustered in the low-recall region, with mean recall below 25%. Gemma-4-26B-A4B achieved the highest precision (55.0%) among general-purpose models but with low recall (12.4%). InternVL3.5-30B-A3B was the best-performing general-purpose model overall (F1 = 23.7%, precision = 47.9%, recall = 16.5%). RetGrounder achieved the highest recall (27.5%) while maintaining competitive precision (48.0%), resulting in a macro F1 of 33.9%—a relative improvement of 43% over InternVL3.5-30B-A3B, the second-best model. It is worth noting that
recall
is particularly consequential clinically:
a spurious box is visible to the reader and can be dismissed at a glance, whereas a biomarker the model never localises leaves no trace in the output for a clinician to check.
In automated or semi-automated setups, this would translate into patients with disease not being referred for further examination.
On the other hand, over-detection would cause unnecessary subsequent assessments, burdening clinical workflows.
Thus, while high recall is fundamental for patient outcomes, the precision of the model also represents a key measure of its applicability in real-world scenarios.
This balance is better achieved by
RetGrounder.

blocks.en: Per-biomarker F1 scores (Fig. 3 a; full per-class breakdowns for all models in Supplementary Tables References – References ) varied substantially across biomarker classes. Macular hole was localised most effectively (RetGrounder F1 = 95.1%, InternVL3.5-30B-A3B F1 = 70.6%). SRF (60.8%), PED (56.4%), and IRF (50.9%) were localised with moderate success by RetGrounder. Hard exudates (F1 = 13.5%), ERM (F1 = 21.7%), and drusen (F1 = 28.7%) proved difficult for all models. The four hardest classes—ellipsoid zone disruption, hyperreflective foci, subretinal drusenoid deposits, and retinal pigment epithelium loss—could not be detected reliably by any model, with even RetGrounder reaching only F1 = 8.9%, 8.1%, 8.5%, and 3.0%, respectively. Fibrosis and RPE loss were the only two classes on which RetGrounder failed to outperform InternVL3.5-30B-A3B, the strongest general-purpose model overall (F1 = 47.5% vs. 49.4% for fibrosis and 3.0% vs. 10.2% for RPE loss).

SRF (60.8%),PED (56.4%),IRF (50.9%)被RetGrower 本地化,并取得了一定的成功. 对所有模型来说,硬出类拔萃(F1 = 13.5%)、机构风险管理(F1 = 21.7%)和德鲁森(F1 = 28.7%)证明是困难的。 四个最困难的类别——椭圆形区扰动、高反射分量、下视网膜德鲁塞诺克矿床和视网膜色素上皮损失——无法被任何模型可靠地检测出,甚至RetGrounder只达到8.9%、8.1%、8.5%和3.0%。 纤维化和RPE损失是RetGrower仅能超过INVL3.5-30B-A3B的两个类别,是整体上最强的通用模型(F1=47.5%对49.4%的纤维化和3.0%对10.2%)。

blocks.en: Mean AggIoU scores (Fig. 3 b) followed a similar pattern but remained universally low, reflecting poor spatial overlap even for detected biomarkers. RetGrounder achieved the highest AggIoU on macular hole (55.0%), the only class where any model exceeded 50%. SRF (30.9%), PED (28.8%), and IRF (24.9%) had moderate overlap, while hard exudates (7.1%) and ERM (11.6%) remained near floor level. The gap between high F1 and low AggIoU for several classes—such as macular hole, where RetGrounder achieved F1 = 95.1% but AggIoU = 55.0%—indicates that while models can identify the correct region, their predicted boxes are often substantially larger or smaller than the ground truth (Fig. 4 ).

blocks.en: Per-biomarker VQA balanced accuracy (Fig. 7 ) varied substantially across classes but followed a different pattern from grounding. blocks.en: 2.4 Grounding and VQA scale with model size, generation, and architecture
blocks.zh: 2.4 有模型大小、生成和结构的地基和VQA尺度

blocks.en: Grounding performance generally improved with model scale in every family (Fig. 8 ), with larger models usually outperforming smaller models. However, the magnitude of the gains differed across model families and generations. Qwen3.5’s performance rose, without a single reversal, from 0.8B (F1 = 1.6%) to 27B (F1 = 18.2%), and InternVL3.5 gained 16.6 F1 points between 1B (7.1%) and 30B-A3B (23.7%), whereas InternVL3 gained only 4.8 points across a nineteen-fold increase in parameters (2B, F1 = 2.6%; 38B, F1 = 7.4%). Nonetheless, there are exceptions to this general trend: Qwen3-VL-8B (F1 = 13.3%) and InternVL3.5-8B (F1 = 15.4%) both scored below their 4B counterparts (16.9% and 16.7%). Thus, while scale reliably predicts the direction of change within a family, it does not predict its magnitude nor the ordering of adjacent sizes. VQA balanced accuracy showed more predictable scaling, generally increasing with model size across all families, with the best models exceeding 70%.
blocks.zh: 定位性能一般会随着每个家庭的模型尺度(图8)而得到改进,较大的模型通常会比较小的模型表现好. 然而,各模范家庭和几代人的收益程度不同。 Quen3.5的性能从0.8B(F1=1.6%)上升至27B(F1=18.2%),在1B(7.1%)至30B-A3B(23.7%)之间,InternVL3.5获得了16.6个F1分,而在参数增加的19倍(2B,F1=2.6%;38B,F1=7.4%)中,InternVL3只获得了4.8分。 然而,这一总趋势也有例外:Qune3-VL-8B(F1 = 13.3%)和InternVL3.5-8B(F1 = 15.4%)的得分均低于其4B对应方(16.9%和16.7%)。 因此,虽然规模可以可靠地预测一个家族内部的变化方向,但它没有预测其规模或相邻大小的顺序. VQA平衡精度显示更可以预测的分级,一般随着模型大小在所有家庭的扩大而增加,最佳模型超过70%.

blocks.en: Improvements over model generations were overall more consistent. Qwen3.6-27B (F1 = 21.0%) outperformed Qwen3.5-27B (F1 = 18.2%) and Qwen3-VL-32B (F1 = 18.8%). InternVL3.5 models outperformed their InternVL3 counterparts at every size, with especially large gains at smaller scales (InternVL3.5-2B F1 = 13.1% vs. InternVL3-2B F1 = 2.6%). However, our fine-tuned 8B RetGrounder still outperformed all open-source models up to 38B parameters, highlighting the benefits of specialization.
blocks.zh: 与模范一代相比,改进总体上更加一致。 Quen3.6-27B(F1 = 21.0%)的成绩超过了Quen3.5-27B(F1 = 18.2%)和Quen3-VL-32B(F1 = 18.8%). InternVL3.5型机型在各种规模上都超过了其InternVL3型机型,在更小的尺度上特别大的收益(InternVL3.5-2B F1=13.1%与InternVL3-2B F1=2.6%). 然而,我们微调的8B RetGrounder仍然比所有开放源代码的模型都好,高达38B参数,突出了专业化的好处.

blocks.en: Three models included both a dense and a mixture-of-experts (MoE) checkpoint of comparable total size: Qwen3.5 (27B dense vs. 35B-A3B MoE), Qwen3.6 (27B dense vs. 35B-A3B MoE), and InternVL3.5 (38B dense vs. 30B-A3B MoE). The MoE checkpoint improved VQA balanced accuracy over its dense counterpart in all three cases (Qwen3.5: 71.0% vs. 70.4%; Qwen3.6: 71.4% vs. 68.6%; InternVL3.5: 67.1% vs. 64.9%). Its effect on grounding F1 was less consistent, improving over the dense checkpoint for InternVL3.5 (23.7% vs. 21.1%) but not for Qwen3.5 (16.6% vs. 18.2%) or Qwen3.6 (13.3% vs. 21.0%).
blocks.zh: 三种模式包括一个密集和混合型专家检查站,总规模相当:Quen3.5(27B密集对35B-A3B MoE),Quen3.6(27B密集对35B-A3B MoE)和InternVL3.5(38B密集对30B-A3B MoE)。 教育部检查站在所有三个案例中都提高了VQA的平衡准确度(Quen3.5:71.0%对70.4%;Quen3.6:71.4%对68.6%;实习生VL3.5:67.1%对64.9%)。 它对F1的停放效果不尽一致,比InternVL3.5(23.7%对21.1%)的密集检查站有所改善,但对Quen3.5(16.6%对18.2%)或Quen3.6(13.3%对21.0%)而言并非如此。

blocks.en: 2.5 Effect of training data composition
blocks.zh: 2.5 培训数据构成的影响

blocks.en:
Fig. 9: Ablation study of RetGrounder’s training data. QA denotes VQA classification data and text-only QA.
Base is the unmodified Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct.
blocks.zh:
发相. 9:对雷特盖特尔的训练数据的研究. QA表示VQA分类数据和文本只表示QA.
基础是未修改的Qwen3-VL-8B-指令.

blocks.en:
RetGrounder is fine-tuned on two kinds of retinal OCT data: bounding-box grounding data, and
question–answering (QA) supervision, comprising classification data recast into VQA form.
It is also trained on text-only QA pairs covering biomarker knowledge (see Methods for more details). To establish what each contributes, we fine-tuned the base Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct on the grounding component alone and on the full mixture, and evaluated both against the unmodified base model. Fig. 9 reports grounding F1 and VQA balanced accuracy for the three resulting models.
blocks.zh:
RetGrounder对两种视网膜OCT数据进行了微调: 边框地取数据,以及
问答(QA)监督,包括重新编入VQA表格的分类数据.
培训内容还包括涵盖生物标志知识的仅文本的质量保证对(详见方法)。 为了确定每一项贡献,我们根据未修改的基模型,单独地对地基组件和全部混合物进行了Quen3-VL-8B-指令的微调。 图9报告说,三个模型的F1和VQA平衡准确。

blocks.en:
Both components contributed, and on both tasks. Fine-tuning on grounding data alone more than doubled grounding F1 relative to the base model (13.3% → \rightarrow 31.4%) and also lifted VQA balanced accuracy (56.8% → \rightarrow 63.7%), indicating that learning to localise biomarkers improves presence detection as well. Adding the
QA
component raised both further, to F1 = 33.9% and BAcc = 71.4%. The two components divide the labour unevenly across the two tasks: grounding data supplies most of the 20.6-point grounding gain (18.1 points, against 2.5 from
QA), whereas the 14.6-point VQA gain is split almost equally between them (6.9 and 7.7 points). Grounding supervision is thus what makes the model localise, but it is not the only source of its VQA ability.
blocks.zh:
这两个部分都作出了贡献,并完成了这两项任务。 仅对地面数据进行精细调整,就比基准模型(13.3% = 右倾31.4%)的F1地面值翻了一番以上,还提高了VQA平衡准确度(56.8% = 右倾63.7%),这表明学习生物标记的本地化也改进了现场检测。 添加
质量保证
F1=33.9%,BAcc=71.4%。 这两个部分将劳动力分布在两个任务中不均匀:地面数据提供20.6分地面收益的大部分(18.1分,而2.5分来自以下两个任务)。
QA),而14.6分的VQA增益则几乎在它们之间平分(6.9分和7.7分). 因此,定位监督是模型本地化的原因,但它并不是其VQA能力的唯一来源。

blocks.en: 2.6 Inter-observer agreement
blocks.zh: 2.6 观察员间协定

blocks.en: To establish a human reference for grounding performance and to test the benchmark’s stability to annotation variability, a subset of 84 B-scans (63 from OCTDL, 21 from OLIVES; at least 20 images per biomarker) was independently re-annotated in a second reading following the same annotation protocol. We treated the two readings as two observers and scored the second read against the original with the same AggIoU matching used for the models (Methods).
blocks.zh: 为了确立一个人性参考基准,用于确定性能,并测试基准的稳定性与注释的可变性,根据同样的注释协议,在二读中独立地重新说明84个B-scans(63个来自OCTDL,21个来自OLIVES;每个生物标记器至少20个图像)。 我们把两个读取作为两个观察者,并用同样的AggIoU相配模型(方法)对正本进行第二读取.

blocks.en: Inter-observer agreement reached a macro F1 of 41.0% (39.9% averaged over both comparison directions) and a mean AggIoU of 26.0% (per-class values in Supplementary Tables References and References ), exceeding the grounding performance of the best model on the same images (RetGrounder F1 = 31.2%; 33.9% on the full benchmark). RetGrounder therefore approaches, but does not reach, the level of agreement between human annotators. Agreement was high for well-circumscribed lesions (macular hole F1 = 90.0%, vitreomacular traction 77.3%, PED 72.5%, SRF 70.6%) and low for epiretinal membrane (15.7%). For epiretinal membrane the disagreement was one of presence rather than localisation: the two readings differed in how often the biomarker was marked at all (presence-level Cohen’s κ \kappa = 0.37, against a mean of 0.55 across the thirteen classes).
blocks.zh: 观察者之间达成了41.0%的宏观F1协议(比较方向均值39.9%),平均AggIoU为26.0%(补充表格参考文献和参考文献中的每类值),超过了同一图像上最佳模型的基础性能(RetGrower F1=31.2%;在全基准上为33.9%)。 因此,RetGrounder接近但并未达到人类注释者之间的协议水平。 环状损伤的商定率很高(大孔F1 = 90.0%,紫外线拉力77.3%,72.5%,70.6%),脊膜低(15.7%)。 对于上层膜来说,分歧在于存在而不是局部化:两种读数在生物标志的标记频率上有所不同(在前一级科恩的o-kappa=0.37,13个类别的平均标记为0.55)。

blocks.en: The benchmark’s model ranking was insensitive to which reading was used as reference: scoring all models against the second reading rather than the original left their ordering essentially unchanged (Spearman ρ \rho = 0.956 across the 28 models, with RetGrounder ranked first under both) and shifted scores downward by a similar margin for every model (mean 2.2 F1 points). The conclusions drawn from RetinaGroundBench therefore do not depend on the annotations of a single reading.
blocks.zh: 该基准的模型排名不敏感,而阅读被用作参考:将所有模型的评分与二读相对,而不是原始模型的顺序基本保持不变(Spearman $\rho = 0.956),在28个模型中,RetGrounder在这两个模型中排名第一),并将每个模型的分数下调一个相近的比分(平均2.2 F1分)。 因此,从RetinaGround Bench得出的结论并不取决于单一阅读的说明。

blocks.en: 3 Discussion
blocks.zh: 3 讨论情况

blocks.en: In this work, we introduced RetinaGroundBench, a benchmark of 815 retinal OCT B-scans annotated with 4,537 bounding boxes across 13 biomarker classes, and used it to systematically evaluate the visual grounding and VQA capabilities of 27 state-of-the-art open-source MLLMs, spanning the most capable model families available at the time of writing. We also proposed AggIoU, both an overlap metric and a matching criterion tailored to the multi-box prediction behaviour of MLLMs, and presented RetGrounder, a domain-adapted 8B model fine-tuned on retinal OCT data.
blocks.zh: 在这部作品中,我们引入了由815个视网膜OCT B-扫描仪构成的基准RetinaGround Bench,该基准被附加了4 537个横跨13个生物标志类的边框,并用它系统评价了27个最先进的开源MLLM的可视地平面和VQA能力,跨越了撰写本报告时最有能力的模范家庭. 我们还提出了AggIoU,它既是一个重叠的度量标准,也是一个适合MLLMs的多箱预测行为的匹配标准,并提出了RetGrowerer,一个域适应的8B模型在视网膜OCT数据上进行了微调.

blocks.en:
Our results reveal that visual grounding of retinal OCT biomarkers remains a challenging and largely unsolved task for general-purpose open-source MLLMs. Even the best general-purpose open-source model achieved a macro F1 of only 23.7%, and all models were characterised by low recall, indicating that they do not yet localise the majority of biomarker instances. The conservative prediction behaviour observed in models such as Gemma-4-26B-A4B—high precision at the cost of very low recall—suggests that these models default to producing few, safe predictions rather than attempting comprehensive localisation, even though the grounding prompt explicitly instructs them to locate every instance of the queried biomarker (Supplementary Table References ).
The substantial heterogeneity in per-biomarker performance likely reflects differences in visual distinctiveness across pathology types. Well-circumscribed pathologies such as macular hole present an unambiguous visual signature, i.e., a full-thickness disruption of the retinal layers that is recognisable even without domain-specific training. In contrast, subtle, diffuse or texture-based biomarkers such as hard exudates and drusen present more irregular or poorly defined spatial extents, with higher visual similarity to normal tissue.
blocks.zh:
我们的结果表明,视网膜OCT生物标记的可视地定位仍然是一项具有挑战性和基本未解决的任务,对通用开源MLLMS来说。 即使最先进的通用开源模型也只实现了23.7%的宏F1,所有模型都以低召回为特征,表明它们尚未将大多数生物标志例本地化. 在Gemma-4-26B-A4B等模型中观察到的保守的预测行为——高精度,以极低的召回成本为代价——建议这些模型默认产生很少的安全预测,而不是试图全面定位,尽管地面的提示明确指示它们查找被询问的生物标记的每一个实例(补充表格参考资料)。
每个生物标记器的性能大相径庭,可能反映了不同病理学类型在视觉特征上的差异. 弯曲的病理,如毛孔等,呈现出一个毫不含糊的视觉特征,即对视网膜层的全毛干扰,即使没有特定域的训练也能识别出. 相形之下,有细微的,弥散的或以纹理为主的生物标志,如硬出类拔萃和德鲁森,呈现出更不规则或定义差的空间范围,与正常组织具有更高的视觉相似性.

blocks.en: The stark contrast between grounding and VQA performance indicates that these two capabilities are not tightly coupled in current MLLMs. RetGrounder dominates grounding yet ranks behind the leading general-purpose models on VQA; conversely, the Qwen3.5 and Qwen3.6 models lead VQA without achieving proportionally strong grounding. The VQA precision–recall landscape shows how some of that VQA strength arises: several models achieved high recall by predicting biomarker presence almost indiscriminately, yielding low precision and inflating balanced accuracy—a metric that weights sensitivity and specificity equally—in a way that would be problematic in deployment, where false positives carry costs. Strong presence detection therefore does not entail strong localisation, nor the reverse; image-level pattern recognition and spatial localisation appear to be distinct capabilities requiring different forms of supervision. Clinically, this means both axes must be evaluated explicitly rather than either being taken as a proxy for the other.
blocks.zh: 地平与VQA性能的鲜明对比表明,这两种能力在目前的MLLMs中没有紧密结合. RetGrounder在VQA上占据了领先的通用模型后方的地基地位;反之,Qun3.5和Qun3.6模型则领先VQA而未实现比例强的地基. VQA精准-召回的地貌显示,这种精准-召回的强度是如何产生的:一些模型通过预测生物标志几乎不加区分地存在,产生低精度并夸大平衡的精度——一个同样衡量灵敏度和特异性的指标——在部署时会产生问题,因为假阳性会带来成本。 因此,强大的存在探测并不要求强有力的本地化,也不要求反向;图像级模式识别和空间本地化似乎是独特的能力,需要不同形式的监督。 在临床上,这意味着必须明确评价这两个轴,而不是作为另一个轴的代名词。

blocks.en: The same dissociation appears at the class level, where correspondence between the two tasks is only partial. Macular hole, the highest-scoring class for grounding (F1 = 95.1%), also scored highest for VQA (BAcc = 92.7%), consistent with its unambiguous visual signature. However, the correspondence breaks down elsewhere: drusen reached 82.7% BAcc despite being among the hardest classes to ground (F1 = 28.7%), indicating that models can recognise drusen from global image features without delineating individual deposits, while fibrosis sat effectively at chance for VQA (BAcc = 50.9%) yet achieved moderate grounding F1 (47.5%), suggesting that when models detect fibrosis at all they can localise it, but that the class is frequently missed entirely. Several factors may underlie this dissociation. Localisation is inherently more demanding than binary presence detection, requiring the model to resolve fine spatial extents rather than aggregate global features. The text-based coordinate format used by current MLLMs may itself be a bottleneck: the vision encoder may capture spatial information that is then lost or degraded when serialised as coordinate tokens through an autoregressive language decoder. Whether the grounding–VQA gap reflects a representational limitation, an architectural mismatch between task and output format, or simply the greater intrinsic difficulty of localisation remains an open question.
blocks.zh: 同样的分解出现在班级层面,两个任务之间的对应只是部分的. Macular洞是地平分最高的得分等级(F1 = 95.1%),也为VQA打出最高分(BAcc = 92.7%),与其清晰的视觉标志一致. 然而,在别处的通信破裂:德鲁森达到了82.7%的BAcc,尽管它属于最难落地的类别(F1 = 28.7%),这表明模型可以从全球图像特征中识别出德鲁森,而不对单个矿床进行分界线,而纤维化在VQA(BAcc = 50.9%)中实际上占了机会,然而却实现了中度地取F1(47.5%),这表明当模型检测出纤维化时,它们可以将其定位,但这一类别常常被完全忽略了。 造成这种分离的因素可能有几个。 本地化在本质上比二进制存在检测要求更高,要求模型解决细微的空间范围,而不是总体的全球地物. 当前 MLLMs 使用的基于文本的坐标格式本身可能是一个瓶颈:视觉编码器可能捕捉到空间信息,当通过自递性语言解码器串行作为坐标符时,这些空间信息会丢失或被降解. 基础-VQA差距是否反映了一种代表限制,任务和产出格式之间的建筑不匹配,或者仅仅是本地化的更内在的困难,仍然是一个有待解决的问题.

blocks.en:
Regarding architecture, MoE checkpoints offered stronger VQA performance than their dense counterparts within each model generation, though the effect on grounding was inconsistent.
Further architectural explanations could be attempted by
comparing models from different families; however,
the differences in both architecture and training data of open-source models make
any such account associative at best. We therefore restrict ourselves to observations.
Strong grounding did not require a large vision encoder: InternVL3.5-30B-A3B, the best general-purpose grounding model in our evaluation, uses one of only 300M parameters. Conversely, the newer Qwen3.5, which introduced hybrid Gated DeltaNet attention, improved VQA markedly while regressing grounding at smaller scales relative to Qwen3-VL; advances in general vision–language capability evidently do not transfer automatically to spatial localisation. What the comparison does establish unambiguously is that none of these differences closes the gap to clinical usefulness: RetGrounder’s 8B model outperformed every open-source model up to 38B parameters on grounding. Thus, targeted fine-tuning on retinal data compensated for a nearly fivefold difference in capacity.
blocks.zh:
在建筑方面,教育部检查站的VQA性能比每一代模式中密集的对口单位要好,尽管对地面布局的影响不一致。
可通过下列方式进一步解释建筑结构:
比较不同家庭的模式;
开源模型的架构和培训数据的差异
充其量是任何此类账户的联系。 因此,我们仅限于观察。
坚固的地平面不需要大型的视觉编码器: InternVL3.5-30B-A3B,是我们评价中最好的通用地平面模型,它只使用了300M参数之一. 相反,较新的Quen3.5引入了混合Gated DeltaNet的注意,显著改进了VQA,同时相对Quen3-VL在较小尺度上倒退;一般视觉-语言能力的进步显然不会自动转移到空间定位上。 比较确实明确无误地证明,这些差异中没有任何一个能弥合这一差距,从而达到临床用途: RetGrounder的8B模型在地上超过每个开源模型,达到38B参数. 因此,对视网膜数据进行有针对性的微调弥补了将近5倍的能力差异。

blocks.en:
The ablation indicates that the two training components during RetGrounder’s fine-tuning play asymmetric roles. Grounding supervision accounts for the bulk of the localisation gain (18.1 of 20.6 F1 points), whereas the VQA gain divides almost equally between the two. Notably, each component also improves the task it is not aimed at: grounding data alone raises VQA balanced accuracy by nearly seven points, suggesting that learning where a biomarker lies reinforces judging whether it is present, and
QA in turn contributes to localisation. The two forms of supervision are therefore complementary rather than redundant. For domain adaptation this argues against treating spatial annotation as optional: it carries most of the localisation signal in our mixture, and image-level labels and text knowledge, though cheaper to obtain, close only a small part of that gap.
blocks.zh:
减幅表明,RetGauer微调期间的两个培训部分扮演着不对称的角色。 定位监督占本地化收益的绝大部分(20.6 F1分中的18.1分),而VQA增益在两者之间几乎平分. 值得注意的是,每个组成部分也改进了它并非旨在完成的任务:仅根据数据就使VQA的均衡准确性提高了近7分,表明了解生物标志的所在将加强判断其是否存在,
质量保证反过来有助于本地化。 因此,这两种监督形式是相辅相成的,而不是多余的。 对于域名的调整,这个观点反对将空间注释视为可选性:它携带着我们混合物中大多数的本地化信号,以及图像级别的标签和文字知识,尽管获得这些标签和文字知识的成本比较低廉,但仅仅缩小了一小部分差距。

blocks.en:
While RetinaGroundBench provides a reproducible reference point for grounded biomarker evaluation in retinal OCT, with RetGrounder narrowing the gap to clinically useful localisation, several aspects remain open.
We set them out below as areas for improvement, each with a concrete next step.
blocks.zh:
虽然RetinaGround Bench在视网膜OCT中为被禁生物标记器评价提供了可复制的参考点,而RetGrounder将差距缩小到临床有用的本地化,但若干方面仍然开放.
下面我们把它们作为需要改进的领域列出,每个领域都有具体的下一步。

blocks.en:
In terms of performance,
RetGrounder has shown suboptimal results for two lesions, fibrosis and RPE loss.
The former is likely a cost of specialisation: fibrosis has no close analogue among the classes RetGrounder was fine-tuned on (Supplementary Table References ), so the general-purpose InternVL3.5-30B-A3B, with no such prior, localises it marginally better (F1 = 49.4% vs. 47.5%).
The low performance for RPE loss, on the other hand, is generalized, with near-floor F1 scores for every model.
Adapting a model to a lesion inventory therefore improves accuracy on those lesions at some cost on unfamiliar targets, which argues for curating fine-tuning data to span a broader range of lesions rather than for abandoning domain adaptation.
blocks.zh:
在表现方面,
RetGrounder显示,两次损伤、纤维化和REPE损失的结果不理想。
前者可能是专门化的成本:纤维化在RetGrounder类中没有近似值(补充表格参考文献)进行了微调,因此通用的InternVL3.5-30B-A3B,没有这种前作,其本地化程度略好(F1=49.4%对47.5%)。
另一方面,REPE损失的低性能被普遍化,每个模型都有近地F1分.
因此,根据损害清单调整一个模型,可以提高这些损害的准确性,而一些费用则用于不熟悉的目标,这说明应调整数据,使之涵盖更广泛的损害,而不是放弃域内适应。

blocks.en:
Regarding fine-tuning data, two main limitations exist. First, the benchmark comprises 815 B-scans drawn from two public datasets (OCTDL and OLIVES) acquired on a limited range of imaging devices, and each image is a single 2D B-scan rather than a full volumetric scan; it may therefore not capture the full diversity of scanner hardware, acquisition protocols, and patient demographics encountered in clinical practice. Expanding the benchmark across additional datasets, imaging devices, and volumetric context would strengthen its representativeness and support more fine-grained analyses.
Second, the bounding-box paradigm itself presents some limitations for the representation of lesions. For instance, drusen and hard exudates commonly present as multiple small lesions scattered across the retina, and there is no canonical way to group such instances into one box versus several. Annotators are known to differ in this granularity [ 22 ] , which likely contributes to the low inter-observer agreement and the low AggIoU observed for some classes, placing a practical ceiling on achievable overlap.
This issue could be mitigated by the use of pixel-level segmentation masks, which are more standardized and represent a more natural fit.
Moreover, evaluating with this type of annotation would establish how much of the observed shortfall is attributable to the annotation format rather than to the models themselves.
blocks.zh:
关于微调数据,存在两个主要限制。 第一,基准包括从有限范围的成像设备上获取的两个公共数据集(OCTDL和OLIVES)取自的815个B-扫描仪,每个图像都是一个2D B-扫描仪,而不是一个完整的卷片扫描仪;因此,它可能无法捕捉到在临床实践中遇到的扫描仪硬件、购置协议和病人人口统计的全部多样性。 将基准扩大到其他数据集、成像装置和体积环境,将加强其代表性,支持更精细的分析。
第二,约束框模式本身对损害的表述提出了一些限制。 例如,通常以分散在视网膜上的多起小损伤来呈现出德鲁森和坚硬的夸大其词,而且无法将此类事件分成一个方框,而不是几个。 据了解,这种颗粒性[22]有不同之处,这可能会造成观测者之间的协议低和一些类别观测到的AggIoU低,对可实现的重叠设置了实际的上限。
这个问题可以通过使用像素级分层口罩来缓解,这些口罩更加标准化并代表着更自然的适合.
此外,用这种说明进行评估,将确定所观察到的不足有多少可归因于说明格式,而不是模型本身。

blocks.en:
Finally, the evaluation also presents some limitations. First, we evaluate only open-source models with native bounding-box output. Frontier closed-source systems are excluded for two reasons. Most do not natively emit bounding-box coordinates, and so cannot be assessed on grounding.
Furthermore, none can be used locally, but only via APIs over internet connections, limiting their applicability to clinical setups, where data privacy is a key concern.
Relatedly, closed-source endpoints are subject to unannounced updates, deprecation, and removal, so results obtained from them cannot be version-controlled or reliably reproduced, hindering benchmarking.
And second, because the evaluated model families differ simultaneously in architecture and training data,
it is not possible to analyse, in a disentangled manner, the impact of each component on model performance.
For this, further controlled studies that vary architecture while holding training data fixed would be needed.
blocks.zh:
最后,评价也有一些局限性。 首先,我们只评价具有本地边框输出的开源模型. 边境封闭源系统被排除在外有两个原因。 大多数人不会在本地排放受限-框坐标,因此无法对地基进行评估。
此外,它们不能在当地使用,而只能通过互联网连接的API使用,限制其适用于临床设置,而数据隐私是临床设置的一个主要问题。
与此相关的是,闭源端点会不经宣布而更新,贬值,去除,因此从这些端点得到的结果无法被版本控制或可靠地复制,阻碍了基准化.
其次,因为被评价的模范家庭在建筑和培训数据上同时不同,
无法以分散的方式分析每个组成部分对模型性能的影响。
为此,需要开展进一步的控制性研究,这些研究在保留固定的培训数据的同时,会改变结构。

blocks.en:
Taken together, our results lead to three main findings. First, strong VQA performance does not imply strong grounding, and vice versa. Models that reliably detect biomarker presence may fail to localise them, and the reverse also occurs.
This implies that clinical deployment requires explicit evaluation of both axes. Second, model scale alone is insufficient for medical visual grounding.
Increasing parameters generally improved grounding across different families, but by highly variable margins,
and the best general-purpose model at 30B remained far below clinical usability.
Third, targeted domain adaptation remains the most effective path to clinically useful grounding: RetGrounder demonstrates that a modestly sized model trained on curated retinal data can substantially outperform much larger general-purpose models. This, however, represents a first step rather than a final solution, and room for improvement remains before clinical applicability; larger-scale curated retinal pretraining, more sophisticated data-mixing curricula, and ultimately prospective clinical reader studies are the natural next steps.
blocks.zh:
总之,我们的结果导致三个主要结果。 首先,强大的VQA性能并不意味着强大的地基,反之亦然. 可靠地检测出生物标记物存在的模型可能无法将其定位,反之也会出现.
这意味着临床部署需要明确评价这两轴。 第二,单是模型尺度不足以进行医疗视觉地面建设。
日益扩大的参数普遍改善了不同家庭的根基,但因幅度变化很大,
30B的最佳通用模型仍然远远低于临床可用性。
第三,目标领域适应仍然是在临床上有用的打地工的最有效途径: RetGrounder表明,一个规模不大的模型经过了对视网膜数据的整理培训,可以大大超过更大的通用模型。 然而,这代表了第一步,而不是最后的解决办法,在临床应用之前,仍有改进的余地;更大规模的视网膜预训,更复杂的数据混合课程,最终未来的临床读者研究是自然的后继步骤.

blocks.en:
To conclude, for an MLLM to be trusted in the clinic, it is not enough that its answers are correct; a clinician must be able to see the evidence behind them. This work provides the most comprehensive assessment of whether current MLLMs meet that standard on retinal OCT, and contributes the three components needed to ask the question: RetinaGroundBench, a benchmark pairing expert biomarker annotations with a text-queried grounding protocol; AggIoU, a metric that scores localisation as MLLMs actually perform it, by aggregating the multiple boxes they emit rather than penalising them; and RetGrounder, which provides a straightforward recipe for narrowing that gap.
The answer, for now, is that state-of-the-art open-source models largely cannot ground their answers on OCT—but that targeted domain adaptation closes much of the distance at a fraction of the parameter count. By releasing the benchmark, the annotations, and the metric, we provide a fixed reference point against which the field can measure that progress as models advance.
blocks.zh:
最后,如果在诊所中相信MLLM,其答案是正确的是不够的;临床医生必须能够看到背后的证据。 这项工作最全面地评估了目前的小额供资和微型企业方案是否符合视网膜OCT标准,并提供了提出问题所需的三个组成部分: RetinaGround Bench, 基准配对专家生物标志说明, 并附有文字排出地标协议; AggIoU, 将本地化评分为 MLLM 实际执行的衡量标准, 方法是汇总它们发射的多箱, 而不是惩罚它们; RetGrounder, 为缩小这一差距提供了直接的方法。
现在的答案是,最先进的开放源代码模型基本上不能用OCT作为答案的基础,但目标域适应在参数数的一小部分关闭了大部分距离。 通过公布基准、说明和衡量标准,我们提供了一个固定的参照点,实地可以据此衡量模型的进展。

blocks.en: 4 Methods
blocks.zh: 4 方法

blocks.en: 4.1 RetinaGroundBench
blocks.zh: 4.1 视网膜圆柱形

blocks.en: We evaluate open-source MLLMs across two axes: visual grounding and visual question answering. To do this, we propose RetinaGroundBench, a dataset composed of 815 retinal OCT images from the public OCTDL [ 21 ] and OLIVES [ 29 ] datasets, annotated with bounding boxes for 13 biomarker classes: pigment epithelial detachment (PED), intraretinal fluid (IRF), subretinal fluid (SRF), drusen, epiretinal membrane (ERM), fibrosis, hard exudates, macular hole, vitreomacular traction, ellipsoid zone disruption, subretinal drusenoid deposits, hyperreflective foci, and retinal pigment epithelium (RPE) loss. In total, the benchmark contains 4,537 ground truth bounding boxes. Table 4 reports the per-class distribution of annotated images and boxes, together with the mean box area of each biomarker.
blocks.zh: 我们评价开源的MLLMs 跨越两条轴线:视觉地面和视觉问答. 为此,我们提出RetinaGround Bench,这是一个数据集,由公共OCTDL[21]和OLIVES[29]数据集的815个视网膜OCT图像组成,并附有13个生物标记类别:色素上皮分解(PED),内皮液(IRF),下皮液(SRF),德鲁森(Drusen),上皮膜(ERM),纤维化,硬排出物,乳腺孔(Macular),紫外线牵引物(Vitreomiculation),椭圆形区扰动,下皮德鲁素矿床(RPE),超反光分化物(RPE)损失。 基准中共有4 537个地面真理界框。 表4按类别报告注释图像和方框的分布情况,以及每个生物标志的正框面积。

blocks.en: Annotations were produced by a team of three ophthalmologists from the Medical University of Vienna. Two junior ophthalmologists independently labelled separate subsets of images, each drawing bounding boxes around all visible instances of the 13 biomarker classes. A senior retina specialist then reviewed, corrected, and approved all annotations. This two-stage workflow—independent junior labelling followed by senior expert adjudication—ensured both annotation throughput and clinical accuracy. Representative annotated images from both source datasets are shown in Fig. 10 .
blocks.zh: 说明由来自维也纳医科大学的三名眼科医生组成的小组编写。 两名初级眼科医生独立标记了单独的图像子集,每个子集围绕13个生物标志类的所有可见实例绘制了相框. 一名高级视网膜专家随后审查、更正并批准了所有说明。 这种分两个阶段的工作流程——独立的初级标签,然后是高级专家的裁决——确保了说明的吞吐量和临床准确性。 两个源数据集中附带说明的代表图像见图10。

blocks.en: Evaluated models were selected based on three criteria: (i) availability of open weights, (ii) explicit support for pixel-level visual grounding with bounding box coordinate output, and (iii) a parameter count of at most 38B. The last criterion reflects the constraint that patient data generally cannot leave the institution, so a model intended for clinical use must be self-hosted on hardware a hospital can realistically operate; we therefore excluded models too large to serve on a single GPU. We restrict the evaluation to open-weight models for the same data privacy concerns but also reproducibility: closed-source systems are subject to unannounced updates, deprecation, and removal, whereas open weights are permanently available and version-controlled, ensuring the benchmark results remain replicable.
blocks.zh: 被评价的模型是根据三个标准选择的:(一) 开放权重的可得性,(二) 明确支持以边框坐标输出的像素级视觉地平面,(三) 参数计数最多为38B. 最后一个标准反映了患者数据一般不能离开医院的制约,因此,一个用于临床的模型必须在医院能够实际操作的硬件上自行托管;因此,我们排除了过于庞大的模型,无法在单一的GPU上服务。 我们把评价限制在相同数据隐私关切的开放加权模型上,但也可以复制:封闭源代码系统会不经事先通知而更新、贬值和去除,而开放加权是永久的,并且可以控制版本,确保基准结果仍然可以复制。

blocks.en: Applying these criteria yields 27 open-source models released up to 30 April 2026, spanning four model families and multiple generations—Qwen3-VL (2B–32B), Qwen3.5 (0.8B–35B), Qwen3.6 (27B–35B), InternVL3 (1B–38B), InternVL3.5 (1B–38B), GLM-4.6V-Flash (9B), and Gemma-4 (2B–26B). We additionally evaluate RetGrounder, a Qwen3-based 8B model we fine-tuned on retinal imaging data. Supplementary Table References lists the exact repository for each evaluated model.
4.2 Aggregated IoU (AggIoU)
blocks.zh: 4.2 综合碘化铀(AggIoU)

blocks.en: Standard object detection metrics such as mean average precision rely on one-to-one matching between predictions and ground truth boxes, penalising models that produce multiple overlapping predictions for a single lesion. In retinal OCT imaging, MLLMs frequently predict several small boxes that collectively cover a ground truth region (Fig. 11 a). Under standard matching, each prediction is evaluated independently and may fall below the IoU threshold despite the set of predictions adequately covering the lesion (Fig. 11 b). To accommodate this behaviour, we propose Aggregated IoU (AggIoU), which aggregates predictions per ground truth box and serves both as an overlap metric and as a matching criterion (Fig. 11 c).

blocks.en: 4.3 Evaluation metrics
blocks.zh: 4.3 评价尺度

blocks.en:
Per-class precision, recall, and F1 are computed from true positive, false positive, and false negative counts accumulated over all images in the combined OCTDL and OLIVES evaluation set; the two source datasets are pooled rather than scored separately. In addition, we report the mean AggIoU score—the per-box ground-truth–union overlap averaged over all ground-truth boxes—as a direct measure of spatial localisation quality independent of the t 2 t_{\scriptscriptstyle 2} threshold. All reported grounding metrics are macro-averaged: per-class scores are computed first, then averaged across all 13 biomarker classes to ensure equal contribution from each class regardless of prevalence.
The two thresholds are set once and held fixed for every model; the values used, and their effect on the results, are given under Implementation details.
blocks.zh:
每等精度、回溯和F1是从OCTDL和OLIVES合并评价集中所有图像所累积的真实正值、假正值和假负值计算出来的;两个源数据集是集合的,而不是单独得分的。 此外,我们报告平均AggIoU的得分,即每盒地-真相-联合在所有地-真相盒上平均重叠,这是对空间定位质量的一种直接衡量,独立于t 2t scripttype 2}阈值。 所有报告的地基测量标准都是宏观平均的:首先计算每类分数,然后对所有13个生物标志类别进行平均计算,以确保每个类别无论普遍程度如何都作出平等的贡献。
这两个阈值为每个模型设定一次,并固定不变;所使用的数值及其对结果的影响,在细节下列出。

blocks.en: For visual question answering, we prompt each model with each of the 13 biomarker classes for every image in the benchmark (815 images), asking whether the given class is present. We compute the balanced accuracy for each class as the mean of sensitivity and specificity, then macro-average across all 13 classes to produce the final metric. This ensures equal contribution from each biomarker, consistent with the grounding evaluation.
blocks.zh: 对于可视化的提问回答,我们用13个生物标志类的每个模型对基准中每个图像(815个图像)进行提示,询问给定的分类是否存在. 我们计算每个类的平衡精确度,作为敏感度和特异性平均值,然后在13个类中进行宏观平均,以产生最终的度量. 这确保了每个生物标志的同等贡献,符合地基评估.

blocks.en: 4.4 RetGrounder
blocks.zh: 4.4 旋转轮

blocks.en: For developing RetGrounder, we fine-tune Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct with LoRA [ 17 ] , which restricts training to low-rank adapters in order to save computation and avoid catastrophic forgetting of the base model’s general capabilities. Training uses a mixture of datasets covering three task types: visual grounding, VQA-style classification, and text-only question-answer pairs. Supplementary Table References summarises the training data composition, and training hyperparameters are given in Implementation details below.
blocks.zh: 为了开发RetGrounder,我们微调了与LORA[17]的Quen3-VL-8B-指令,将训练限制在低等适配器,以节省计算,并避免灾难性地忘记了基础模型的一般能力. 训练使用包含三种任务类型的数据集的混合:视觉地平面,VQA式的分类,和文本只回答对. 补充表格的参考文献概述了培训数据的组成,培训超参数载于下文的执行细节。

blocks.en:
The primary grounding data source is an in-house dataset of 34,112 OCT B-scans extracted from 934 volumetric OCT scans acquired on Spectralis devices (Heidelberg Engineering). The volumes span geographic atrophy, intermediate AMD, and neovascular AMD cohorts. Pixel-level segmentation masks for 8 lesion classes (reticular pseudodrusen, IRF, hyperreflective foci, retinal pigment epithelium elevations, SRF, subretinal hyperreflective material, outer retinal tubulation, and hypertransmission) were produced by trained graders using a semi-automated pipeline: an initial segmentation model generated candidate masks, which were then manually reviewed and corrected by expert graders. Not all classes are annotated in every image.
To convert pixel-level masks to bounding boxes, we applied a contour-detection and clustering approach. For each class, connected components were extracted from the binary mask, discarding regions below a minimum area threshold; spatially proximate contours of the same class were then merged, to avoid fragmenting a single lesion instance into multiple small boxes, and the enclosing bounding box of each cluster was taken as the final annotation. All bounding box coordinates were normalised to a [ 0 , 1000 ] [0,1000] coordinate system. Supplementary Table References details the per-class distribution, totalling 154,548 bounding boxes.
blocks.zh:
主要地基数据源是从Spectralis设备(海德堡工程)上获得的934个体积OCT扫描中提取出34,112 OCT B-scans的内部数据集. 体积覆盖了地理萎缩、中间AMD和新血管AMD组群。 8个损伤类别(视网膜伪德鲁森、IRF、超反光共生菌、视网膜色素上皮高程、SRF、下视网膜超反光材料、外视网膜输管和超传播)的像素水平分层口罩由受过训练的分层人员使用半自动管生产:初始分层模式生成候选口罩,然后由专家分层人员进行人工审查和纠正。 并非所有的课都附加了每个图像的注释.
为了将像素级口罩转换为边框,我们采用了等相探测和集群方法. 对每个类,从二进制口罩中取出相接的组件,丢弃低于最小区域阈值的区域;然后将同类的相近空间轮廓相并并用,以避免将单个损伤实例分解为多个小框,并将每个集群的相接边框作为最后注释. 所有边框坐标被正常化为[0,1000] [0,1100]坐标系统. 参考文献详细列出每班的分发情况,共计154 548个捆绑箱。

blocks.en: We also convert several public segmentation datasets to bounding box labels using the same rule-based approach. We use 1,199 images from OIMHS [ 37 ] covering IRF and macular hole, 3,012 images from RVO-ME [ 34 ] covering IRF, SRF, external limiting membrane, ellipsoid zone, and hyperreflective foci, and 928 images from OCTAVE [ 20 ] covering ERM. We also use 566 images (4,698 bounding boxes) from OCT5k [ 4 ] which already come in bounding box form, covering hard drusen, soft drusen, drusenoid PED, photoreceptor layer disruption, reticular pseudodrusen, choroidal folds, geographic atrophy, hyper fluorescent spots, and IRF.
blocks.zh: 我们还使用同样的规则方法,将若干公共分块数据集转换为边框标签。 我们使用来自OIMHS[37]的1,199个图像,覆盖IRF和毛孔;来自RVO-ME[34]的3,012个图像,覆盖IRF、SRF、外部限制膜、椭圆形区和超反射分光层;来自OCTAVE[20]的928个图像,覆盖机构风险管理。 我们还使用来自OCT5k[4]的566个图像(4,698个边框),这些图像已经以边框形式出现,覆盖了硬德鲁森,软德鲁森,德鲁森德PED,光受体层扰动,矩形假德鲁森,胆固醇折叠,地理萎缩,超荧光斑,以及IRF等.

blocks.en: Classification datasets are converted into VQA format where the model is prompted to identify the disease or lesion present in the image. We use all 24,000 images from C8 [ 27 ] covering AMD, CNV, CSR, DME, DR, drusen, macular hole, and normal retina; 16,979 images from Kermany [ 19 ] covering CNV, DME, drusen, and normal cases; all 572 samples from OCTID [ 13 ] covering AMD, CSR, DR, macular hole, and healthy retinas; and 4,205 images from an in-house classification set covering RVO, CNV, Stargardt disease, iAMD, GA, DME, and healthy retinas.
blocks.zh: 分类数据集被转换为VQA格式,该模式被激发来识别图像中存在的疾病或损伤. 我们使用来自C8[27]的所有24 000个图像,涵盖AMD、CNV、CSR、DME、DR、drusen、Macular洞和正常视网膜;来自Kermany[19]的16 979个图像,涵盖CNV、DME、drusen和正常病例;来自OCTID[13]的所有572个样本,涵盖AMD、CSR、DR、macular洞和健康的视网膜;以及来自内部分类组的4 205个图像,涵盖RVO、CNV、Stargardt疾病、iAMD、GA、DME和健康的视网膜。

blocks.en:
We generate 300 text-only question-answer pairs covering OCT biomarker knowledge without any accompanying images. Generation proceeded iteratively using three frontier LLMs (Claude, ChatGPT, and Gemini): each model was prompted to produce question-answer pairs spanning biomarker definitions, inter-class relationships, differential diagnosis, spatial localisation on OCT B-scans, and clinical significance. The 230 general OCT knowledge pairs cover topics such as the relationship between related biomarker classes (e.g. PED vs. RPE elevations), OCT appearance descriptions, and differential features. An additional 70 spatial reasoning pairs test anatomical layer relationships (e.g. “If intraretinal fluid is in the outer plexiform layer and subretinal fluid is below the photoreceptors, which is deeper?”). After generation, each pair was cross-checked by the other two LLMs for factual accuracy; pairs flagged as incorrect by any model were revised or discarded.
Supplementary Table References shows representative examples of the prompts used for evaluation and training across the different task types.
blocks.zh:
我们生成300个仅文本的问答对,涵盖OCT生物标志知识,没有任何相伴随的图像. 一代人利用三个前沿LLM(Claude, ChatGPT,和双子座):每个模型都受到激励,产生涵盖生物标志定义、阶级间关系、差别诊断、OCT B-扫描仪上的空间定位以及临床意义等的问答对子。 230个普通OCT知识对涵盖了相关生物标志类(如PED与RPE高程)之间的关系,OCT外观描述,以及差异特征等专题. 另有70个空间推理对子测试解剖层关系(例如,“如果视网膜内液体位于外圆形地层,而视网膜下液体位于光受体下方,这更深?”). 生成后,每一对都经过了其他两个有限责任公司对事实准确性的核对;任何模型标出不正确的一对被修改或丢弃。
参考文献显示了在不同任务类别中用于评价和培训的提示的典型例子。

blocks.en: 4.5 Implementation details
blocks.zh: 4.5 详细执行情况

blocks.en: RetGrounder was trained with the LlamaFactory [ 40 ] library for 77k steps with an effective batch size of 8, an initial learning rate of 10 − 5 10^{-5} with a 0.1 warm-up ratio, and a cosine-with-restart learning rate scheduler. LoRA was applied to the entire model with a rank of 64 and an alpha of 128, using a 90–10% train–validation split.
blocks.zh: RetGrounder在LlamaFactory[40]图书馆受训,共77k步,有效批量规模为8步;初始学习率为10-5 10-Q-5},热身比为0.1;同心复起的学习进度计. LoRA被应用到整个型号上,等级为64等,α为128等,采用90-10%的列车-验证分出.

blocks.en: Mask-to-bounding-box conversion for the in-house and public segmentation datasets used OpenCV contour detection to extract connected components, discarding regions below a minimum area threshold, followed by DBSCAN clustering with a distance threshold of 25 pixels to merge spatially proximate contours of the same class.
blocks.zh: 内部和公用分块数据集的遮罩-对接-框转换使用OpenCV等同位素检测来取出相接组件,丢弃低于最小区域阈值的区域,再由DBSCAN集群,相距阈值为25像素来将同级的相邻空间等同位素相接.

blocks.en: AggIoU was computed with t 1 = 0.1 t_{\scriptscriptstyle 1}=0.1 and t 2 = 0.3 t_{\scriptscriptstyle 2}=0.3 for all models: a permissive gathering threshold allows even small overlapping fragments to contribute to the union, while the moderate acceptance threshold ensures that the aggregated prediction still covers a meaningful portion of the ground truth. An internal sweep over threshold pairs confirmed that the ranking of models is stable across a wide range of settings.
blocks.zh: AggIoU是用t 1 = 0.1 t_{\scripttyle 1}=0.1和t 2 = 0.3 t_{\scripttyle 2}=0.3 对所有模型进行计算:一个可允许的集合阈值允许甚至小相重叠的碎片为结合出力,而中度的接受阈值则确保汇总预测仍能覆盖地心真言中有意义的部分. 一次对阈值对进行内部扫描,证实模型的排名在广泛的设置中是稳定的.

blocks.en: Inference for every evaluated model family was run from the model’s public Hugging Face repository (Supplementary Table References ) using each family’s reference implementation. A self-contained pipeline reproducing the full grounding evaluation is available at the repository given under Code availability.
blocks.zh: 对每个被评价的模范家庭的推论均取自该模范的公共Hugging Face存储处(补充表格参考文献),使用每个家庭的参考文献。 根据《守则》的可用性,储存库可提供自成一体的输油管,复制完整的地面评价。

blocks.en: 6 Data availability
blocks.zh: 6 数据提供情况

blocks.en: The RetinaGroundBench benchmark is derived from two publicly available datasets: OCTDL ( https://github.com/MikhailKulyabin/OCTDL ) and OLIVES ( https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.7105232 ). Our bounding box annotations and evaluation code are publicly available at https://github.com/ronnief1/RetinaGroundBench .
blocks.zh: RetinaGround Bench基准来自两个可公开查阅的数据集:OCTDL(https://github.com/MikhailKulyabin/OCTDL)和OLIVES(https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.7105232). 我们的边界框说明和评价代码可在https://github.com/ronnief1/RetinaGround Bench上公开查阅。

blocks.en: The RetGrounder training mixture additionally draws on seven public datasets: OIMHS ( https://doi.org/10.6084/m9.figshare.23508453.v1 ), RVO-ME ( https://doi.org/10.6084/m9.figshare.29804435.v1 ), OCTAVE ( https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.14580071 ), OCT5k ( https://doi.org/10.5522/04/22128671.v4 ), C8 ( https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/obulisainaren/retinal-oct-c8 ), Kermany ( https://data.mendeley.com/datasets/rscbjbr9sj/2 ), and OCTID ( https://borealisdata.ca/dataverse/OCTID ). The in-house training data used to fine-tune RetGrounder cannot be shared due to data-sharing restrictions.
blocks.zh: RetGtaller培训混合物还取自7个公共数据集:OIMHS(https://doi.org/10.6084/m9.figshare.23508453.v1)、RVO-ME(https://doi.org/10.6084/m9.figshare.29804435.v1)、OCTAVE(https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.14580071)、OCT5k(https://doi.org/10.5522/04/22128671.v4)、C8(https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/obulisainaren/retinal-oct-c8)、Kermany(https://data.mendeley.com/datasets/rscbbr9sj/2)和OCTID(https://borealisdata.ca/datavers/OCTID)。

blocks.en: 7 Code availability
blocks.zh: 第7条 代码可用性

blocks.en: A self-contained pipeline that reproduces the visual grounding evaluation end-to-end—dispatching inference for every evaluated open-source model family, parsing their predictions, and computing AggIoU from a single command—is available at https://github.com/ronnief1/RetinaGroundBench . All 27 evaluated open-source models are publicly available on Hugging Face; their exact repository identifiers are listed in Supplementary Table References .
blocks.zh: 自成一体的管道复制了视觉地基评价端到端的推论,为每一个被评价的开源模型家族提供推论,解析他们的预测,并从单一指令中计算出AggIoU。 所有27个经评价的开源模型均在Hugging Face上公开提供;其精确的存储器识别资料列于补充表格参考资料.。
